Open Start and type your shop name, the cut-off hour and your own limits in the yellow cells: late days, packing minutes, labour cost and claim days.
Check Carriers and Carrier Rate Table: one row for each carrier and zone with fees, delivery days and phone. Prices and costs fill in.
Fill Regions and Zones with your delivery regions, their sales tax rate and zone, and Channel Order Rules with cut-offs and shipping charges.
Add every order on Orders and its products on Order Lines. Totals, promised days, days to ship and late checks fill in.
Use Order Pipeline every morning for open orders, and Dispatch Board for the parcels leaving today.
Log minutes on Pick and Pack Log and read the pace check. Record parcels on Shipments to see the shipping gap.
Compare the promise with real days on Delivery Times and follow every problem parcel on Late and Lost Parcels.
Record cancellations, address and payment problems, and wholesale orders on their own sheets.
Keep Packaging Stock, Fulfilment Roster and Peak Plan up to date before busy weeks. Daily Order Summary feeds the averages.
Use the 14 calculators for shipping cost, carrier choice, shipping gap, delivery date, packing capacity, peak staff, packaging and what-if cases.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready messages.
Read the dashboard and Charts every week. Amounts are plain numbers in one currency and sales tax rates are demo values: check your own.
See what every return costs and keep customer service on target
Returns, refunds, tickets and reviews: see what each return really costs
Return reasons with causes and fixes
two typical causes for each of the eight return reasons, the fix, its owner and due date, and the returns each cause explains
Return rate by product with break-even
each product's return rate is checked against your limits and against the rate at which its margin is gone after label, handling and stock lost
the return label, the handling and the stock lost on a write-off, a second or a supplier credit are added up for each return
days from the request to the refund, a check against your quick refund limit and a flag for refunds that are due or overdue
every returned unit gets a grade and a decision, and the value recovered and the value lost are worked out from the landed cost
faulty units sent back are turned into claims with the goods value, the days open, the credit received and the amount not credited
Damaged in transit and carrier claims
each parcel that arrived damaged is logged with the carrier, the packaging and a photo flag so that the claim is made in time
Ticket queue with response targets per topic
every ticket is checked against the response hours of its topic, with days open and the customer's rating
Return and service trend by month
returns, return rate, tickets per 100 orders, response hours, satisfaction and reviews side by side for every month
low-star reviews without a reply are flagged, each review is assigned to an agent and the average stars of every product is kept
products with a quality problem get an action, an owner, a due date and the return rate that shows whether the fix works
the vouchers sent after a bad experience are tracked until used and the margin won after the voucher cost is worked out

Returns: every return request from request to refund
One row per return request with reason, status, refund and restock decision; days to refund, the refund check and the net cost of the return (label, handling, stock lost) fill in by themselves.
Return reasons: typical causes and fixes
Two typical causes for each of the eight return reasons, the fix, who owns it and the date it is due; the number of returns it explains and the state of the fix fill in by themselves.
Return rate by product, with the rate each product can bear
Units sold and returned per product over the whole history; the return rate, the check against your limits, the loss on one return, the break-even rate and the stars fill in by themselves.
Return rate by channel and month
Orders, units, returns, refunds and the cost of returns for each channel and month over the whole history; the return rate, returns per 100 orders and the average refund fill in by themselves.
Service log by month: tickets, response times, reviews
One row per month with tickets, response and resolution times, satisfaction and reviews; orders, returns and the rates fill in by themselves.
Return policy by channel and category
The return window, who pays the label, the condition and the usual restock decision for every channel and category; the label cost the shop carries fills in by itself.
Refunds: what was paid back, how and who approved it
One row per refund paid with the amount, the sales tax inside it, the method and who approved it; the order, customer, share of the order value and the wait after receipt fill in by themselves.
Restock decisions: what happens to each returned unit
One row per inspected return with the grade and the decision; the product, the stock value, the value recovered and the value lost fill in by themselves.
Supplier claims for faulty returned units
One row per claim to a supplier for returned units: units, goods value, credit received and dates; phone, days open, gap and claim state fill in by themselves.
One row per customer ticket with topic, priority, status, assignee, first response, resolution and rating; the topic target, the check and days open fill in by themselves.
Two standard answers for each of the eleven ticket topics with the response target and owner; tickets, average first response and tickets over target fill in by themselves.
One row per customer review with stars, comment and the reply; the product, the number of stars as a figure and whether the review still needs a reply fill in by themselves.
Product quality issues and what is done about them
Products whose returns point to a quality problem with the action, owner and due date; the supplier, the return rate and the state of the action fill in by themselves.
Parcels damaged in transit and the carrier claims
One row per return caused by damage in the parcel with carrier, packaging and photo; order, customer, product, amount not paid and claim state fill in by themselves.
Win-back vouchers after a bad experience
One row per customer who got a voucher after a bad experience, with the value, the date sent and whether it was used; the margin won and the state fill in by themselves.
One row per payment dispute with the amount, the date evidence is due, the evidence sent and the outcome; the days left, the state and the cost of the dispute fill in by themselves.
Service roster: who answers customers each week
One row per team member and week with the shift, the hours and the tickets handled; tickets per hour and the share of the week fill in by themselves.
Products: the catalogue behind every return and review
The 40 products with category, supplier, cost and web price, sorted with the most returned first; the product name with its variant and the margin on the web price fill in by themselves.
Suppliers: faulty returns, claims and credits
The 12 suppliers with contact details; units sold and returned of their products, the return rate, the claims sent and the credit received fill in by themselves.
Team: who handles returns and customers
The team with phone numbers for the message links.

Hello {customer}, your return {return_id} for {product} is approved. Your return label is attached. Please pack the item in its original box and hand the parcel to the carrier.
Hello {customer}, we received your return {return_id} ({product}). We are checking the item and will pay your refund of {refund_amount} soon.
Hello {customer}, your refund of {refund_amount} for return {return_id} was sent on {refund_date}. It can take a few days to show in your account.
Hello {customer}, we are very sorry that {product} from order {order_id} arrived damaged. A replacement ships today and you do not need to send the damaged item back.
Hello {customer}, we are sorry about {product} in order {order_id}. Please send a photo of the item and of the box so that we can fix this today.
Customer: the return window has ended
Hello {customer}, we are sorry, the return window for order {order_id} has ended, so we cannot approve return {return_id}. We would like to offer a voucher for your next order instead.
Customer: wrong item, new one coming
Hello {customer}, we sent the wrong item in order {order_id}. The correct {product} is on its way and a label for the wrong item is attached. We are sorry.
Customer: we are looking into it
Hello {customer}, we are looking into your ticket {ticket_id} about {topic}. We will write again within {target_hours} hours.
Hello {customer}, your ticket {ticket_id} is resolved. Did our answer help? Please reply with a number from 1 to 5, where 5 is very helpful.
Customer: thank you for your review
Hello {customer}, thank you for your review of {product}. It helps other customers and our small team a lot.
Customer: voucher for your next order
Hello {customer}, we are sorry about your last experience. Here is a voucher of {voucher} for your next order, valid for 45 days.
Hello {customer}, we issue a credit note for the damaged goods in return {return_id} ({product}, {qty} units). The credit of {refund_amount} is applied to your account.
Hello {customer}, please fill in the damage form for order {order_id} and send it with photos of the boxes or the pallet. We need it before we can claim from the carrier.
Hello {name}, please check the tickets that are over their response target today and answer the oldest ones first.
Lead: reason trend on a product
Hello {owner}, the returns of {product} show a trend: {issue}. {units_returned} units came back, a return rate of {return_rate}. Please look at the pattern this week.
Lead: new macro for a topic
Hello {owner}, please review the standard answer {title} for the topic {topic}. Check the tone and the facts before we add it to the list.
Hello {agent}, please answer review {review_id} for {product} today. Customer: {customer}. The review says: {comment}.
Warehouse lead: returns to inspect today
Hello {name}, please inspect the returns that arrived today and enter a restock decision for each one.
Hello {checked_by}, {product} came back damaged again (return {return_id}, packed in: {packaging}). Please check the packing before the next parcel goes out.
Warehouse: restock units of a product
Hello {inspected_by}, please put {units} units of {product} back on the shelf ({decision}, {grade}) and update the stock count.
Hello {owner}, the return rate of {product} is {rate}. The main reason is {top_reason}. Please look at the listing, the packing and the supplier.
Hello {handled_by}, claim {claim_id} for {supplier} is ready: {units} units of {product}, worth {amount}. Please send it today.
Hello {name}, the weekly returns report is ready. Please read the return rate by product and the open supplier claims before our meeting.
Hello, {units} units of {product} were returned as faulty. Please send a credit note for {amount}. Our claim is {claim_id} and our return is {return_id}.
Hello, customers report a quality problem with {product}: {issue}. {units_returned} units have come back so far. Please tell us the cause and how you will fix it.
Hello, the parcel for order {order_id} arrived damaged ({product}). We have photos and ask you to open a claim for {value}. Our reference is {return_id}.
Hello {name}, the returns cost for this month is ready on the dashboard. Please look at the cost of returns and at the products above the return limit.
Hello {owner}, the listing of {product} may cause returns: {issue}. Please check the photos, the size and the description this week.
Return {col:returns.return_id} for order {col:returns.order_id}, requested on {col:returns.date}. Customer: {col:returns.customer}.

Your return is approved. Please pack the item in its original box with the paper note, stick the return label on the parcel and hand it to the carrier. The label cost is {col:returns.return_ship_cost}.
When the parcel arrives we inspect the item. The refund of {col:returns.refund_amount} is paid back to you after the check. Please keep your proof of posting until the refund is paid.
We paid back {col:refunds.amount} on {col:refunds.date} by {col:refunds.method}. The amount holds {col:refunds.items} for the items and {col:refunds.tax} of sales tax.
The refund is {col:refunds.share} of the order total of {col:refunds.order_total}. It can take a few working days to show in your account.
Thank you for your patience. If anything looks wrong, please write to us and quote the refund number.
Return summary report for a month
Month starting {col:bymonth.month}. The shop shipped {col:bymonth.orders} orders and {col:bymonth.units_sold} units.
Customers sent back {col:bymonth.units_returned} units in {col:bymonth.returns} returns, a return rate of {col:bymonth.return_rate}. Our accepted rate is {set:return_limit}.
Refunds paid were {col:bymonth.refund_value}. The cost of returns, with labels, handling and stock lost, was {col:bymonth.return_cost}.

Customer service answered {col:bymonth.tickets} tickets, {col:bymonth.tickets_100} for every 100 orders. The first answer took {col:bymonth.avg_first_hours} hours on average and {col:bymonth.over_target} tickets were over target.
The average satisfaction score was {col:bymonth.csat} out of 5 and the average review was {col:bymonth.avg_stars} stars.
Supplier claim letter for returned units
Our customers returned {col:claims.units} units of {col:claims.product} ({col:claims.sku}) as faulty. The goods value of these units is {col:claims.amount}.
Please send a credit note for this amount or replace the units. We have photos and the inspection notes and can send them on request.
Please confirm the claim and the credit within {set:claim_days} days. We also ask you to tell us what caused the fault and what you will change.
Product: {col:quality.product}. Supplier: {col:quality.supplier}. Issue {col:quality.issue_id}, first seen on {col:quality.first_seen}.
Problem: {col:quality.issue}. Main return reason: {col:quality.reason}. {col:quality.units_returned} units came back, a return rate of {col:quality.return_rate}.
Action: {col:quality.action}. Owner: {col:quality.owner}. Due on {col:quality.due}. The action check shows: {col:quality.state}.
We review this issue every month until the return rate is back under {set:return_limit}.
Customer service weekly report of {set:shop}, dated {today}.
Hours worked: {col:roster.hours}. Tickets handled: {col:roster.tickets_handled}, which is {col:roster.per_hour} tickets for every hour and {col:roster.week_share} of the tickets of the week.
Our targets: first answer within the hours set for each topic, a ticket resolved within {set:resolve_days} days and a satisfaction score of {set:csat_goal} out of 5.
Please add your notes on repeated questions and on products that cause tickets.
Review summary report for a product
The product has {col:rbp.review_count} reviews with an average of {col:rbp.avg_stars} stars. Our goal is {set:rating_goal} stars.
Of {col:rbp.units_sold} units sold, {col:rbp.units_returned} came back, a return rate of {col:rbp.rate}. The main reason is {col:rbp.top_reason}. The rate check shows: {col:rbp.flag}.
The product can bear a return rate of {col:rbp.breakeven} before its margin is gone. We use this report to decide on listing changes, packing changes and supplier talks.
Dispute {col:disputes.dispute_id} for order {col:disputes.order_id}, amount {col:disputes.amount}, opened on {col:disputes.date}. Reason given: {col:disputes.reason}.
We ask you to review the order of {col:disputes.customer}. We hold the order confirmation, the proof of delivery and the messages with the customer, and attach them to this letter.
The goods were packed and handed to the carrier as described in the order. We believe the charge is correct and ask you to close the dispute in our favour.
Evidence is due on {col:disputes.due}. Please confirm that you received this letter.
